nrql.uptime: SELECT 100 - (count(apm.service.error.count) / count(apm.service.transaction.duration) * 100) AS value FROM Metric WHERE entity.guid IN ({{GUIDS}}) {{RANGE}}
nrql.responseMs: SELECT average(apm.service.transaction.duration) * 1000 AS value FROM Metric WHERE entity.guid IN ({{GUIDS}}) AND transactionType = 'Web' {{RANGE}}
nrql.errors: SELECT sum(newrelic.error.group.occurrences) AS value FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'newrelic.error.group.occurrences' AND (error.group.issueType = 'Error' OR error.group.issueType IS NULL) AND entity.guid IN ({{GUIDS}}) {{RANGE}}
nrql.errorRate: SELECT count(apm.service.error.count) / count(apm.service.transaction.duration) * 100 AS value FROM Metric WHERE entity.guid IN ({{GUIDS}}) {{RANGE}}
nrql.alerts: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM NrAiIncident WHERE event = 'open' AND priority = 'critical' AND (error.group.issueType = 'Error' OR error.group.issueType IS NULL) AND entity.guid IN ({{GUIDS}}) {{RANGE}}
nrql.perHost: SELECT count(apm.service.transaction.duration) AS throughput, average(apm.service.transaction.duration) * 1000 AS responseMs, count(apm.service.error.count) AS errorEvents FROM Metric WHERE entity.guid IN ({{GUIDS}}) FACET {{HOST_ATTR}} {{RANGE}} LIMIT 20
nrql.perHostErrors: SELECT sum(newrelic.error.group.occurrences) AS errors FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'newrelic.error.group.occurrences' AND (error.group.issueType = 'Error' OR error.group.issueType IS NULL) AND entity.guid IN ({{GUIDS}}) FACET {{HOST_ATTR}} {{RANGE}} LIMIT 20
nrql.perHostAlerts: SELECT count(*) AS alerts FROM NrAiIncident WHERE event = 'open' AND priority = 'critical' AND (error.group.issueType = 'Error' OR error.group.issueType IS NULL) AND entity.guid IN ({{GUIDS}}) FACET {{HOST_ATTR}} {{RANGE}} LIMIT 20
nrql.topErrors: SELECT sum(newrelic.error.group.occurrences) AS count FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'newrelic.error.group.occurrences' AND (error.group.issueType = 'Error' OR error.group.issueType IS NULL) AND entity.guid IN ({{GUIDS}}) FACET `error.group.message`, `error.group.name`, {{HOST_ATTR}}, `entity.guid` {{RANGE}} LIMIT 12

jira._note: Only metrics that need no further definition are here. Story points, planned, cycle time, aged bugs, escalation hours and capacity are deliberately absent — see the README.

metrics.label: New bugs
metrics.jql: project = {{PROJECT}} AND issuetype = Bug AND created >= "{{FROM}}" AND created < "{{TO}}"

metrics.label: Resolved bugs
metrics.jql: project = {{PROJECT}} AND issuetype = Bug AND resolved >= "{{FROM}}" AND resolved < "{{TO}}"

metrics.label: Open bug tickets
metrics.jql: project = {{PROJECT}} AND issuetype = Bug AND statusCategory != Done

metrics.label: High priority bugs older than 90 days
metrics._note: Describes the backlog as it stands when the fetch runs. Past weeks cannot be reconstructed, so history accumulates from the first run.
metrics.jql: project = {{PROJECT}} AND issuetype = Bug AND statusCategory != Done AND priority = High AND created <= -90d

metrics.label: Medium priority bugs older than 90 days
metrics._note: Describes the backlog as it stands when the fetch runs. Past weeks cannot be reconstructed, so history accumulates from the first run.
metrics.jql: project = {{PROJECT}} AND issuetype = Bug AND statusCategory != Done AND priority = Medium AND created <= -90d

metrics.label: Planned at sprint start
metrics.note: Issues in the sprint report minus those added after the sprint began.

metrics.label: Added after sprint start
metrics.note: Issues the sprint report lists as added once the sprint was running.

metrics.label: Capacity available (person-weeks)
metrics.note: Each person's available share of the week, 100% = 1, summed across the team.

metrics.label: Cycle time, median (days)
metrics.note: In Progress to resolved, median over the issues resolved that week.

metrics.label: New tech debt tickets
metrics.jql: project = {{PROJECT}} AND {{TECHDEBT}} AND created >= "{{FROM}}" AND created < "{{TO}}"

metrics.label: Resolved tech debt tickets
metrics.jql: project = {{PROJECT}} AND {{TECHDEBT}} AND resolved >= "{{FROM}}" AND resolved < "{{TO}}"

metrics.label: High priority tech debt older than 90 days
metrics.jql: project = {{PROJECT}} AND {{TECHDEBT}} AND statusCategory != Done AND priority = High AND created <= -90d

metrics.label: Medium priority tech debt older than 90 days
metrics.jql: project = {{PROJECT}} AND {{TECHDEBT}} AND statusCategory != Done AND priority = Medium AND created <= -90d
